title: Mover Profile
description: One person's situation, in a vocabulary shared by every country pack. This is what makes heterogeneous decision trees comparable: each pathway declares machine-evaluable criteria against these fields, so the same profile can be run against every country at once. Every field is optional — an absent field yields 'check' rather than a false negative, because guessing on someone's behalf is worse than telling them what to confirm.

label.description: Human name for this profile, e.g. 'Retiring couple, modest pension'.

age.description: Years. Gates retirement routes in Thailand (50) and Cambodia (55).

retired.description: Not working, and able to evidence it. Retirement routes require this as well as age.

annualIncomeUsd.description: Earned income, from employment or self-employment.

passiveIncomeUsd.description: Pension, benefits, dividends, rent. Distinct from earned income because retirement routes test this specifically.

liquidSavingsUsd.description: Cash you can park and evidence, e.g. Thailand's THB 500,000 DTV requirement.

investableCapitalUsd.description: Capital you would genuinely commit and leave in place. Not the same as savings.

netWorthUsd.description: Total assets, for wealth-tested routes such as Thailand's LTR Wealthy Global Citizen.

familyTie.description: 'spouse' of a citizen, 'ancestry' meaning heritage or former nationality, 'child' meaning a citizen child. By a wide margin the cheapest routes in the region, and the most commonly overlooked.

employerIsLocalEntity.description: Whether the hiring entity is actually registered in the destination country. A foreign company with no local entity cannot sponsor anyone.

employerIsLargeEnough.description: Whether the employer clears local headcount and capital tests — Thailand's 4:1 Thai-to-foreign ratio, Cambodia's Foreign Manpower Quota. Rules out startups.

isEmployee.description: Employee rather than freelancer or business owner. Several remote-work routes in the region exclude freelancers outright.

needsWorkAuthorization.description: Whether you need to work legally for a local employer. Many long-stay routes permit residence but not work.

needsLocalBanking.description: Whether you need a local bank account. Now decisive in Thailand, where the DTV's tourist classification blocks it.

wantsPermanence.description: Whether permanent residence or citizenship is the actual objective, as opposed to indefinite renewable stay.

maxStayMonths.description: How long you want to stay. Separates a visit from a move.
